phrases.trick: 'nowadays' al final marca temporalidad B2. Evita decir 'in my opinion, I think' (redundante).
phrases.template: In my opinion, [X] is one of the most important things in our lives nowadays.

phrases.trick: 'strongly' + verbo de opinion refuerza. OJO: esta frase te OBLIGA a hablar de pros y contras despues.
phrases.template: I strongly believe that [X] has both advantages and disadvantages.

phrases.function: Opinar sobre temas sociales o de actualidad
phrases.trick: 'plays a key role' es collocation B2 pura.
phrases.template: From my point of view, [X] plays a key role in [ambito].

phrases.trick: 'widely recognised' = pasiva impersonal, suena academico. Usala en temas serios (medio ambiente, IA, educacion).
phrases.template: It's widely recognised that [X] has become increasingly relevant in [ambito].

phrases.function: Opinar sobre cambio social con idiom B2/C1
phrases.trick: 'There's no denying' es idiom B2/C1. Perfecta para temas de cambio (tecnologia, IA, trabajo remoto).
phrases.template: There's no denying that [X] has transformed the way we [verbo].

phrases.trick: Termina la razon con un phrasal verb: unwind, switch off, clear my mind.
phrases.template: For example, in my case, I usually [verbo] [complemento] because [razon corta].

phrases.trick: Cambiar a pasado simple demuestra dominio de tiempos. Usa adjetivos intensificados: absolutely breathtaking, completely exhausting.
phrases.template: Let me give you an example: last [periodo], I [pasado simple] and it was [adjetivo intensificado].

phrases.trick: 'whenever' > 'when'. 'End up feeling' es phrasal verb B2. Adjetivos: drained, overwhelmed, refreshed.
phrases.template: In my own experience, whenever I [verbo presente], I end up feeling [adjetivo emocional].

phrases.function: Ejemplo a traves de otra persona
phrases.trick: Oracion de relativo + 'a friend of mine' = construccion nativa. Usala cuando el tema no te toca personalmente.
phrases.template: A clear example of this is what happened to a friend of mine, who [pasado simple] and [consecuencia en pasado].

phrases.trick: 'came up' + 'I'd like to mention' = registro formal. Ideal para Parte 4 cuando quieres sonar reflexivo.
phrases.template: To illustrate this, I'd like to mention something that came up [periodo]: I [pasado simple] and realised that [reflexion].

phrases.trick: OJO: 'helps us SAVE' (sin 'to'). Decir 'helps us TO save' es B1.
phrases.template: One of the main advantages of [X] is that it helps us [verbo + complemento].

phrases.trick: OJO: tras 'such as' solo sustantivos o gerundios, NUNCA infinitivos. Drawbacks B2: addiction, lack of, over-reliance, burnout.
phrases.template: However, [X] also has some drawbacks, such as [sustantivo] or [sustantivo].

phrases.function: Par de conectores rey: ventaja y desventaja
phrases.trick: Intensificadores OBLIGATORIOS: quite overwhelming, really addictive, extremely time-consuming.
phrases.template: On the one hand, [X] makes our lives [adj+]. On the other hand, it can become [adj- intensificado].

phrases.trick: 'overlook' > 'forget'. 'Although' > 'but'. 'Generally' suaviza y suena maduro.
phrases.template: Although [X] is generally [adj+], we shouldn't overlook [consecuencia negativa].

phrases.trick: 'it's worth mentioning that' es expresion B2/C1. 'Numerous benefits' > 'many benefits'.
phrases.template: While [X] offers numerous benefits, it's worth mentioning that [problema concreto].

phrases.trick: OJO: 'Despite + sustantivo', NUNCA 'despite of'. 'Bear in mind' es idiom B2.
phrases.template: Despite the obvious benefits of [X], it's important to bear in mind that [contrapeso].

phrases.trick: 'far more' > 'much more' > 'more'. 'When it comes to' es idiom B2.
phrases.template: [X] is far more [adjetivo] than [Y], especially when it comes to [sustantivo].

phrases.trick: 'have their merits' = collocation B2/C1. 'Lean towards' = phrasal verb B2 (mejor que 'prefer').
phrases.template: Both [X] and [Y] have their merits, but I personally lean towards [X] because [razon solida].

phrases.trick: 'tends to be' suaviza la afirmacion, suena maduro. Estructura paralela demuestra control discursivo.
phrases.template: While [X] is ideal for [proposito], [Y] tends to be a better option when you want to [verbo].

phrases.trick: 'whereas' es conector formal (mas que 'but' o 'while'). Suena escrito, sube nivel.
phrases.template: There are clear differences between [X] and [Y]: whereas [X] [verbo + caracteristica], [Y] [verbo + caracteristica opuesta].

phrases.trick: 'more and more' = comparativo progresivo B2. 'Are + -ing' = presente continuo para tendencia actual.
phrases.template: This means that more and more people are [verbo + -ing] these days.

phrases.trick: 'has become' = presente perfecto, B2 puro. Ambitos: our daily routine / modern life / the workplace.
phrases.template: As a result, [X] has become an essential part of [ambito].

phrases.trick: 'will keep + -ing' = futuro + continuidad. 'In the years to come' > 'in the future'.
phrases.template: That's why I believe [X] will keep [verbo + -ing] in the years to come.

phrases.trick: 'couldn't have imagined' = condicional perfecto. 'Reshaped' y 'Consequently' son lexico B2/C1.
phrases.template: Consequently, [X] has reshaped [ambito] in ways we couldn't have imagined a decade ago.

phrases.trick: Tres expresiones B2 en una frase: 'all things considered' + 'here to stay' + 'use it wisely'. Ideal para temas modernos.
phrases.template: All things considered, [X] is here to stay, and we just need to learn how to use it wisely.

phrases.function: Cierre con idiom 'for better or for worse'
phrases.trick: 'for better or for worse' es idiom potente. 'Genuinely' refuerza opinion.
phrases.template: To sum up, I genuinely believe [X] has changed the way we [verbo], for better or for worse.

phrases.trick: 'in a nutshell' (= resumiendo) + 'double-edged sword' (= arma de doble filo) = 2 idioms B2/C1. Ideal para temas controvertidos.
phrases.template: In a nutshell, [X] is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.

phrases.function: Cierre con conector condicional 'as long as'
phrases.trick: 'as long as' = conector condicional B2. 'Play a major role' = collocation B2.
phrases.template: Ultimately, I'm convinced that [X] will continue to play a major role, as long as we [condicion].
